title: A ward of your house
text: A widowed cousin of a Great House asks you to foster their youngest for a few years — a ward, an honor, and unmistakably a mouth to feed.

effects.tpl: The child arrives with one trunk and excellent manners. Your house grows warmer and worthier. +15 prestige, +12 karma.
You send toys and a kind letter instead. The cousin understands — mostly.
